name: Texas FFA Association
what_you_do: Take an agricultural science class at school and join your local FFA chapter. FFA is a student-led leadership group. Members earn degrees and can join contests, speaking events and leadership programs.
grades: Agricultural science classes start no earlier than 7th grade. Junior FFA starts at 3rd grade.
who_can_apply: Students who sign up for an agricultural science class at a school with an FFA chapter. The FAQ says the grade depends on the district and that home-schooled students are not covered by the program. Junior FFA needs age 8 and 3rd grade.
pay_detail: National dues $7 plus Texas dues $9 is $16 a year, not counting area, district or local dues. Junior FFA is $9 a year (state only).
duration: School year, tied to your agricultural science class
deadline_text: No application deadline. You join through your school's agriculture program.
how_to_apply: Your first contact is your local agricultural science teacher. Sign up for an agricultural science class.
notes: Junior FFA is a state-only membership at $9 a year, says the membership page.
